interpretation: For these list-state swaps, nearly all of the causal effect of L8H7/L8H3 is carried by the layer-0 cached value at the final visible label; the score and layer-8 own-value parts are not sufficient.
declared_limit: Every registered answer-preserving control keeps the final label token fixed, so the selected cached-value transplant is exactly a no-op on those controls. This cleanly establishes dependence on final-label identity but is not a collateral-damage removal test on unrelated circuits. Weight compilation, removal, OOD, and cross-format transfer remain open.
